note.text: Every model response traces back to a mine, a river, and a warehouse somewhere, not just a server rack in a clean diagram. The interface hides lithium extraction, water-cooled data centers, and the underpaid people labeling training data so the output feels weightless. Treating intelligence as something that simply happens in software lets organizations ignore the physical and human supply chain they now depend on. The map of what a system actually costs is longer, and more extractive, than the map of what it can do.
